recognize_zh: 這是紅血球 PNH 分析的門控圖：在對數刻度的前向散射（FS）對側向散射（SS）圖上，框出主要的紅血球族群（B gate），並排除左下方低散射的碎片與血小板，之後再以 CD59 分出第 I、II、III 型紅血球。
features: Log-scale forward scatter (x) versus side scatter (y) plot gated on singlets
Dense elongated red cell population enclosed by gate B at FS ~10^1.5-10^2
Low-scatter debris/platelet events excluded at lower left
Sparse high-FS/SS events at upper right outside the gate (doublets or leukocytes)
No antigen expression shown; gating step only
describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot of log forward scatter versus log side scatter, gated on singlets, shows a dense, elongated red blood cell population enclosed by gate B, with low-scatter debris and platelet events excluded at the lower left and sparse larger events outside the gate. This is a gating step in red cell PNH analysis and does not by itself demonstrate a PNH clone; the gated red cells are subsequently analyzed for CD59 expression to quantify type I, II and III cells.
